[Section] Results
[source_id=37] We evaluate Jasper across a number of datasets in various domains. In all experiments, we use dropout and weight decay as regularization. At training time, we use speed perturbation with fixed +/-10% BIBREF29 for LibriSpeech. For WSJ and Hub5'00, we use a random speed perturbation factor between [-10%, 10%] as each utterance is fed into the model. All models have been trained on NVIDIA DGX-1 in mixed precision BIBREF30 using OpenSeq2Seq BIBREF31 . Source code, training configurations, and pretrained models are available.
